methods.method: Enumerate the recursive Git tree at accepted h. Result: 107 tracked files under experiments/**; no tracked experiments/moves/** namespace remains.
Inspect tracked Python imports and import-from edges. Static-import negatives are not accepted as proof of no consumer.

Use tests/refoundation/codebook_consumer_analysis.py and tests/refoundation/test_det_batch_retirement.py as tracked evidence for module-by-string, importlib.import_module, __import__, importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, legacy facade, bootstrap, and output-path consumer classes.

Inspect .claude/commands/triage-alpha.md, triage-beta.md, and triage-emit.md. They name experiments/foundry_enrich.py, tier_engine-derived loaders, experiments/out/foundry/review, decision outputs, and legacy reconcile paths operationally.
Inspect .github/workflows/build.yml. Negative result at accepted h: no direct experiments/** invocation in this workflow. This is not generalized to other command/script consumers.

Read Objective-3 result and parser/interpreter inventory at evidence head 6b7e1fa. Live legacy policy/product surfaces include foundry_common.py, foundry_det_pass.py, tier_engine.py, and compatibility wrappers foundry_shape_extractor.py, foundry_locality.py, and foundry_object_lattice.py.

Inspect tests/refoundation/test_layout_delegation.py. It records foundry_common.py as a high-fan-in compatibility boundary (83 importers in the measured layout evidence), pins dynamic/legacy layout shapes, and proves prior experiments/moves fixture relocation to tests/fixtures/ground_truth.

Read refoundation/conservation/OUTPUT-EXCEPTION-CENSUS.yaml. It reports 3,321 known ignored experiments/out/** files, 110 distinct referenced paths, 9 unresolvable dynamic shapes, and explicitly makes no claim about unreferenced ignored bytes.

Inspect src/mtj_foundry/paths.py. It defines permanent config/src/archive/var/benchmark ownership and legacy paths, while explicitly stating that accepted destination naming does not authorize physical moves.
Inspect .gitignore at accepted h. experiments/out/ is ignored; var/ is not ignored. Ignored status is treated as an ownership fact, never as disposal evidence.

Inspect docs/RATIFIED-RULINGS-REGISTRY.md, tests/guards/gate2/foundry_ruling_registry.py, and cleanup REMOVAL-LEDGER evidence. Document population, ruling IDs, raw reference multiplicity, sole-home/corroborated state, and intentional false positives participate in conservation.
Enumerate tests/fixtures/ground_truth/**. These tracked fixtures encode behavior/ground truth and are live truth, not historical clutter.

dependency_law: Absence from static imports is not sufficient. A candidate remains blocked unless static, dynamic, subprocess/shell, command, test/fixture, workflow, package/config, direct-open/path-constant, operational-doc, authority/selector, baseline/ratchet, generated-output, and meaningful transitive consumer classes are accounted for.
limitation: This GitHub-side Manager session cannot inspect arbitrary untracked/ignored local bytes. Any readiness claim depending on such bytes is BLOCKED_UNKNOWN until a clean local pre-S15 revalidation proves ownership and regeneration.
